ribbon-editor-done.title: Done / Cancel
ribbon-editor-done.description: Footer Done commits the draft to the live ribbon and saves; Cancel and the ✕ close discard the draft. Done is the only path that persists.

ribbon-pin-group.title: Pin to Ribbon (drag-drop)
ribbon-pin-group.description: Dragging content onto the ribbon strip pins it as a new button: a tab, a file action, or an OS payload like a dropped URL. The drop position computes the insert index; duplicate pins are rejected with a flash. Handlers are auto-discovered per workspace.

ribbon-pin-tab.title: Pin a Dragged Tab
ribbon-pin-tab.description: Drag a tab onto the ribbon to bake it into a button. An ITabPinHandler for the tab's page kind (file-system folder, registry key, tabular transform chain, …) snapshots its exact state; otherwise the tab's current title/icon/params are pinned as-is.

ribbon-pin-fileaction.title: Pin a File Action
ribbon-pin-fileaction.description: Drag a file action onto the ribbon (FileAction drag format) to pin it as a button that re-runs the action against the current selection. Backed by IRibbonPinHandler for creation and IRibbonItemExecutor for click-time run.

ribbon-pin-url.title: Pin a Dropped URL
ribbon-pin-url.description: Drag a URL out of the browser onto the ribbon (native UniformResourceLocator format) to pin a Web button that re-opens that address. Backed by Web's IRibbonPinHandler.

ribbon-pin-dedup.title: Duplicate-pin Rejection Flash
ribbon-pin-dedup.description: Attempting to pin a button that already exists (same page kind + params) is rejected; the existing button flashes its opacity to signal the duplicate.

ribbon-layout-sync.title: Per-profile Layout + Live Sync
ribbon-layout-sync.description: The ribbon layout belongs to the Profile (shared by every Workspace on it) and persists to ribbon.json. Any edit saves immediately and raises Profile.RibbonChanged so every other window/workspace on the profile reloads its strip live; the originating window skips its own reload.

ribbon-defaults.title: Bundled Default Items
ribbon-defaults.description: The shipped default-ribbon.json seeded on first run (or Reset / empty ribbon): Projects · This PC · AI Chat · Scratchpad · Processes · Documents/Pictures/Videos/Music. Known-folder tokens ({Documents}, {Pictures}, …) expand to real paths at load.

theme-system.title: Theming System
theme-system.description: The layered theme engine: how a theme is built, switched, frozen and extended, and the shared colour banks every region and feature binds.

theme-layered-assembly.title: Layered Assembly
theme-layered-assembly.description: ThemeManager.Apply merges five dictionaries in fixed precedence order — palette -> region tokens -> feature contributions -> per-theme overrides + scenes -> styles — skipping missing optional layers.

theme-base-palette.title: Base Palette
theme-base-palette.description: Layer 1: each Colors.<Theme>.xaml supplies the same structural key set (Bg/Surface/Accent/Text/... as Color + Brush) plus gradients and chrome dimensions; deliberately tone-neutral (no GreenBrush/OrangeBrush).

theme-region-tokens.title: Region Tokens
theme-region-tokens.description: Layer 2 ({Region}.{Role} keys in Tokens.xaml): each shell region (Chrome/Ribbon/TabStrip/AiBar/FileList/...) binds its own namespaced colour handle that default-aliases the palette, so a theme can restyle one region without touching the rest.

theme-themed-region.title: ThemedRegion + Scene Backdrops
theme-themed-region.description: The generic ThemedRegion wrapper renders three layers behind any named region's content — a Scene.<Region> animated backdrop, a {Region}.Bg tint veil, then the content; inert (zero extra visuals) when a theme supplies neither.

theme-scene-ocean.title: OceanReefScene
theme-scene-ocean.description: Procedural reef backdrop (sun glow, god rays, floor caustics, drifting fish, swaying coral, rising bubbles); density scales with region size and it never hit-tests. Theme art for Ocean's Scene.Window.

theme-scene-forest.title: ForestScene
theme-scene-forest.description: Dappled-woodland backdrop — warm canopy light fading to a shaded forest floor; drives Nature's Scene.Window.

theme-scene-gothic.title: GothicScene
theme-scene-gothic.description: Midnight backdrop — near-black sky with a bruised-purple moon bloom over a tower and fog; drives Gothic's Scene.Window.

theme-scene-sandstone.title: SandstoneWall
theme-scene-sandstone.description: Warm cut-stone masonry backdrop lit by a slowly travelling sun; drives Sandstone's Scene.Window.

theme-scene-sunny.title: SunnyScene
theme-scene-sunny.description: Bright cheerful sky warming toward the horizon, with drifting balloons/confetti; drives Sunny's Scene.Window (proves the scene mechanism works for light themes too).

theme-swatch-bank.title: Categorical Swatch Bank
theme-swatch-bank.description: Swatch.* — a dozen mutually-distinct hues for components needing recognisably different colours next to one another (pie/chart series, category dots, colour pickers); defaults in Tokens.xaml, art-directed per theme.

title_path: Rule: a feature never hard-codes a colour

theme-textswatch-palette.title: Code Colour Palette (TextSwatch)
theme-textswatch-palette.description: TextSwatch.* — role-named tokens (Comment/Keyword/String/Number/Type/Function/...) the editor colourizers read at paint time for syntax highlighting; kept separate from Swatch.* so each theme art-directs code to its own mood.

theme-semantic-tokens.title: Semantic Status Tokens
theme-semantic-tokens.description: Meaning-not-tone brushes (SuccessBrush/WarningBrush/DangerBrush, OnAccentBrush, AccentSubtleBrush, AiStatus.* dot states) kept mutually distinct so success/warning/danger never blend; defaults in Tokens.xaml.

theme-contribution.title: Feature Theme Contributions
theme-contribution.description: IThemeContribution lets a feature ship fallback theme resources (pack-URI ResourceDictionaries) discovered by reflection and merged at layer 3 — below the active theme, so a theme can override any contributed key by string name with no Core<->feature reference.

theme-selection.title: Theme Selection (Options)
theme-selection.description: Options > Shell exposes a Theme combo with a live colour-swatch preview; the chosen ThemeOption is saved to ShellConfig and (per the inline notice) takes effect on window restart.

theme-switch-restart.title: Theme Switch (Window Restart)
theme-switch-restart.description: Because brushes bind via {StaticResource} (resolved once, for render perf), switching theme re-runs ThemeManager.Apply then RestartWindowForTheme rebuilds the acting window in place — same position, same tabs (order + active preserved) — against the new theme.

theme-freeze-on-merge.title: Freeze-on-Merge
theme-freeze-on-merge.description: After all layers merge, FreezeResources freezes every Freezable resource (brushes/gradients/effects) so they are immutable, thread-safe to read from per-window UI threads, and skip per-use change tracking; best-effort per key.

ws-profile-selector.title: Profile Selector
ws-profile-selector.description: The coloured icon button in the window chrome showing the active profile's symbol on its colour. Left-click opens a popup list of all profiles to switch the active workspace; right-click opens a Configure / New-workspace menu. Disabled (no switch) while a modal overlay is open.

ws-switch-profile.title: Switch Profile
ws-switch-profile.description: Picking a profile from the selector popup reconfigures the current workspace in place: cancels any in-flight AI send, collapses to this window (closing the others), repoints to the new profile, closes tabs, and rebuilds providers + AIService + ribbon. Modal overlays block switching.

ws-modal-block-switch.title: Modal Switch Block
ws-modal-block-switch.description: While the Options or Manage-AI/Configure overlay is open, profile switching and the selector's right-click menu are disabled (CanSwitchProfile is false) — those panels edit the active workspace/profile, so the workspace must stay put.

ws-options-list.title: Workspaces List (Options)
ws-options-list.description: The Options → Workspaces page: one editable row per profile (icon tile, name, symbol, colour) with per-row Configure / Clone / Delete actions and an '+ Add Workspace' button. Backed by editable row copies that only commit on Apply.

ws-clone.title: Clone Workspace
ws-clone.description: Duplicates a profile with a fresh icon/colour, copying its AI config, persona and provider configs into a new on-disk folder. Available both as the Options list 'Clone' button and as the selector's right-click 'New workspace…' (which clones the current one and opens Configure on it).

ws-delete.title: Delete Workspace
ws-delete.description: Permanently removes a profile and its on-disk data (config + every conversation). Confirmation-gated; refuses the last remaining profile and one a live workspace uses (the Options 'Delete' button is hidden for the active workspace). The Configure panel's Delete closes the workspace's windows first, then deletes.

ws-reorder.title: Reorder Workspaces
ws-reorder.description: Drag the icon tile of a row in the Options list to reorder profiles; a ghost-frame adorner follows the cursor. The edited order syncs to the live Profiles list (and the selector dropdown / JumpList) on Apply.

ws-identity.title: Identity Editor
ws-identity.description: First page of the Configure panel: edit a workspace's Name, Symbol and Colour against an in-memory copy with a live preview tile, committing only on Apply (a rename moves the on-disk data folder). Includes inline validation (non-empty, no name collision).

ws-colour-swatches.title: Colour Swatches
ws-colour-swatches.description: Per-profile colour picker drawing from the shared categorical Swatch.* bank (Blue/Cyan/Teal/…/Slate), plus a hex text box. Same bank in the Options list and the Configure identity page so both offer the theme's palette; throws on a missing swatch key.

ws-reconfigure-in-place.title: Reconfigure In Place
ws-reconfigure-in-place.description: After a provider-config or grid change the workspace's runtime is rebuilt for its current profile: tabs close, the feature cache is evicted, providers are re-acquired (warming new models, cooling dropped ones) and the AIService rebuilt, then a default tab reopens. A workspace-scoped feature-config change instead does a full RestartWorkspace (fresh workspace + swapped window).

ws-export-conversations.title: Export Conversations
ws-export-conversations.description: Identity page action: pick a folder (via the themed folder picker) and save every conversation in this workspace as markdown files (one per conversation), with a toast reporting the count.

ws-jumplist.title: Taskbar JumpList
ws-jumplist.description: A Windows taskbar JumpList with one 'Workspaces' task per profile, each launching the exe with --context "Name" to open straight into that profile. Rebuilt whenever the profile list changes; failures are swallowed (cosmetic).

ws-single-instance-ipc.title: Single-Instance IPC
ws-single-instance-ipc.description: A single-instance guard: a second launch doesn't start a new process — it forwards a new-window request (honouring --context) over IPC to the running instance, which opens a window in a NEW workspace. The IPC listener is started during app init.

ws-prestart-daemon.title: Resident Daemon (--prestart)
ws-prestart-daemon.description: Launched with --prestart, the app initialises fully but shows no window and creates no workspace — it stays resident after init so the next click/JumpList signal opens a window instantly. It also stays alive windowless instead of shutting down on last-window-close (unless an update is committing).

win-cux-split-empty.title: Split Empty Pane
win-cux-split-empty.description: Adds an empty right-hand pane to an unsplit window, focusing it so the next opened tab lands there. Disabled once already split (v1 is two panes max).

win-cux-close-pane.title: Close Pane
win-cux-close-pane.description: Collapses the split back to one pane, moving the closed pane's tabs into the survivor (remove-then-add so each PaneView releases and re-adopts the page control).

win-cux-open-in-new-window.title: Open in New Window
win-cux-open-in-new-window.description: Spawns a fresh shell window in the current workspace and opens the chosen page in it. Exposed by the ribbon item / tab context-menu 'Open in New Window' action.

win-cux-tab-drag-transfer.title: Cross-Window Tab Drag
win-cux-tab-drag-transfer.description: Drag a tab and drop it onto another pane or another window's tab strip to move it there. Within a window it moves between panes; across windows ShellServices re-keys the tab from its source window to the drop target. Dropping off all windows tears it off into a new one.

win-cux-window-registry.title: Multi-Window Registry
win-cux-window-registry.description: ShellServices tracks every open window of a workspace and which window owns each tab, tracks the focused window (new tabs / AI context route there), and on last-window-close releases the workspace's resources (and quits the app when no window remains anywhere, unless resident).

win-cux-dpi-placement.title: DPI-Aware Placement
win-cux-dpi-placement.description: Window-positioning helpers that read the cursor's monitor DPI and work area so torn-off windows drop at the cursor, replacement windows reopen where the old one was, and a follow-up window opens on the same monitor — all in WPF logical pixels.

win-cux-file-picker.title: Themed File Picker
win-cux-file-picker.description: An in-app, theme-styled Open/Save file browser (drive-rooted tree, extension filtering, double-click to confirm) used instead of the OS dialog. Reused via IShellServices.PickOpenFileAsync / PickSaveFileAsync, owned by the focused window.

win-cux-folder-picker.title: Themed Folder Picker
win-cux-folder-picker.description: An in-app, theme-styled folder browser (drive-rooted directory tree, pre-expands to an initial path) used instead of the OS dialog. Reused via IShellServices.PickFolderAsync and by Export Conversations, owned by the focused window.

visuals-text.title: Visuals.Text
visuals-text.description: Shared WPF text stack (Nexaflow.Visuals.Text): the markdown render/diagram engine AND the AvalonEdit-based code/text editor. Used by Core's AI overlay + 7 features.

vtext-editor.title: Code/Text Editor
vtext-editor.description: The shared AvalonEdit editor surface (windowed document, encoding/EOL options, built-in commands) reused by the Code, Text and Markdown editors.

vtext-editor-host.title: Editor Host
vtext-editor-host.description: FileTextEditorView/ViewModel: the document host, line numbers, selection, find, the editor command surface.

vtext-highlighting.title: Highlighting Host
vtext-highlighting.description: Binds the Syntax engine into AvalonEdit: HighlightingRegistry (ext→engine), TreeSitterColorizer (paints spans), XshdTheming (retints built-in defs to the theme).

vtext-codeblock.title: CodeBlockView
vtext-codeblock.description: Read-only syntax-highlighted code block, reused by the Notebook code cells and markdown fenced code.

vtext-selectable-markdown.title: Selectable Markdown
vtext-selectable-markdown.description: SelectableMarkdownView / MarkdownFlowDocument: copy-aware rendered markdown used by the AI overlay and AIChat.

vtext-pipeline.title: Markdown Pipeline
vtext-pipeline.description: The single shared Markdig pipeline (MarkdownPipelineFactory) every markdown surface parses with.

syntax.title: Syntax Engine (tree-sitter)
syntax.description: Nexaflow.Syntax: the tree-sitter parse + highlight engine. Shared by the Code editor, Notebook, Product Manager and Visuals.Text.

syntax-queries.title: Highlight Queries
syntax-queries.description: Per-grammar capture→role queries that drive colouring.

syntax-injections.title: Embedded Languages
syntax-injections.description: LanguageInjections: finds embedded sub-ranges (JS/CSS in HTML, Ruby in ERB, SQL in heredocs) and re-parses them, recursing.

syntax-parse-tree.title: Parse Tree (AI)
syntax-parse-tree.description: CodeHighlighter.GetParseTree → the s-expression syntax tree exposed to the AI / graphify (get_syntax_tree).

syntax-outline.title: Code Outline / Structure
syntax-outline.description: CodeOutline + CodeStructureExtractor: the class/structure map data behind the Code editor's class view.

visuals-terminal.title: Visuals.Terminal
visuals-terminal.description: Shared terminal control (Nexaflow.Visuals.Terminal): VT rendering, view-model, command classification, key/history handling. Used by Core + the Console feature.

vterm-view.title: Terminal View
vterm-view.description: TerminalView: the VT/ANSI render surface with selection, copy and scrollback.

vterm-classifier.title: Command Classifier
vterm-classifier.description: CommandClassifier: decides whether typed input is a shell command or an AI prompt.

vterm-keys.title: Keys & History
vterm-keys.description: TerminalKeys: key handling, command history, and Tab completion plumbing.

vterm-environments.title: Environments Model
vterm-environments.description: Per-location terminal environments (TerminalEnvironment / EnvVar / EnvScope) the Console binds master/detail.

io-terminal.title: IO.Terminal (PTY)
io-terminal.description: Nexaflow.IO.Terminal: the pseudo-console (ConPTY) backend — process host, VT screen state, job-object lifetime. Used by Visuals.Terminal + Console.

ioterm-screen.title: Terminal Screen
ioterm-screen.description: TerminalScreen: the VT parser / screen-buffer state.

ioterm-job.title: Process Lifetime
ioterm-job.description: TerminalJobObject: ties the child process tree to the tab so it's torn down cleanly.

io-common.title: IO.Common
io-common.description: Nexaflow.IO.Common: WPF-free file leaves shared by ~18 consumers — encoding sniff, file watching, glob, text transforms, and the archive virtual-filesystem facade.

iocommon-encoding.title: Encoding Detector
iocommon-encoding.description: EncodingDetector: BOM + UTF-8 sniff (the canonical detector reused by the text/log/tabular readers).

iocommon-filewatch.title: File Change Watcher
iocommon-filewatch.description: FileChangeWatcher: debounced FileSystemWatcher wrapper behind IShellServices.WatchFile.

iocommon-glob.title: Glob
iocommon-glob.description: Glob: the shared glob matcher (folder-action content rules, file-map criteria).

iocommon-vfs.title: Virtual File System
iocommon-vfs.description: IVirtualFileSystem / VirtualFileSystem / VirtualEntry: the facade that lets the file explorer browse archives like folders.

iocommon-codecs.title: Codec / Archive Contracts
iocommon-codecs.description: IStreamCodec / IArchiveHandler / IArchiveEncryptor: the contracts the Compressed backends implement.

iocommon-transforms.title: Text Transforms & Hashing
iocommon-transforms.description: TextTransforms, LineEnding, Base64Codec, Hashing, FileSplitter — shared byte/text utilities.

visuals-common.title: Visuals.Common
visuals-common.description: Nexaflow.Visuals.Common: the shared WPF controls, converters and formatters used by Core and nearly every feature view.

vcommon-controls.title: Shared Controls
vcommon-controls.description: PieChart, SparklineChart, SunburstControl (the Product sunburst), ThemedRegion (the animated-scene region wrapper).

vcommon-converters.title: Value Converters
vcommon-converters.description: The shared converter bank (Bool/Null/Count/Enum/String→Visibility, ColorString→Brush, …) used across feature XAML.

vcommon-formatters.title: Formatters
vcommon-formatters.description: SizeFormatter, DurationFormatter and BytesToTextConverter — shared human-readable formatting.

vcommon-collections.title: Collections
vcommon-collections.description: RangeObservableCollection: batched add/clear to avoid per-item CollectionChanged churn.

providers-common.title: Providers.Common
providers-common.description: Shared provider contracts: ILlmProvider, the Llm message/response/attachment types, ProviderModel, IProviderConfig.

projects-buckets.title: Archive / Shelf / Reactivate
projects-buckets.description: Project lifecycle: Archive and Shelf move a project to its configured folder and Reactivate moves it back, via a safe background copy-then-delete (IShellServices.MoveFolderInBackground) that shows a Moving project... pane and refreshes when done.

projects-migration.title: Schema migration (v2)
projects-migration.description: The .project file is schema v2; legacy files load tolerantly in memory and prompt to upgrade, folding Scope / Notes / Implementation Plan / Test Plan into the new markdown fields and objectives into completion criteria.

projects-backlog-viewlet.title: Backlog folder viewlet
projects-backlog-viewlet.description: File-explorer viewlet shown when a folder contains a .project: a per-status backlog breakdown (coloured chips) plus an Open project shortcut; a single-bar with a left logo strip.

projects-backlog-ai.title: Task to AI / Plan with AI
projects-backlog-ai.description: Two backlog-editor buttons that open a new conversation seeded with the item and the project folder pinned as a FileSystem context item, auto-sending a perform-this-task or plan prompt.

svg.title: SVG
svg.description: SVG vector image viewer (.svg/.svgz): crisp WPF vector rendering, pan/zoom, transparency checkerboard, AI tools

svg-loader.title: SVG Loader
svg-loader.description: Parse .svg/.svgz to a frozen DrawingImage off-thread (gzip sniff + XXE-hardened) with a metadata probe

svg-viewer.title: Viewer
svg-viewer.description: Canvas render, pan/zoom, fit-to-window, checkerboard toggle, load gating and error overlay

run-in-sandbox.title: Run In Sandbox
run-in-sandbox.description: Use the windows sandbox feature to execute exe's and other shell runables in the sandbox

calculator.title: Calculator
calculator.description: graphing calculator - with latex entry support

email.title: Email
email.description: Viewer for .eml (MimeKit) and .msg (MsgReader) files: envelope headers (raw list collapsed), body rendered/plain/HTML-source, and attachments opened through the archive VFS.

email-open.title: Open As Email
email-open.description: The 'As Email' file action (/email) and the .eml/.msg default-open mapping open the Email viewer tab.

email-parse.title: Message parsing
email-parse.description: Parse .eml (MimeKit) and .msg (MsgReader) into one EmailDocument: envelope, raw headers, text/HTML bodies, attachment-vs-inline split, embedded message/rfc822.

email-attachments.title: Attachments
email-attachments.description: Attachments exposed as VFS entries (EmailArchiveHandler/Session) so opening one launches its own viewer; a shell-default (PDF) is materialised first, and nested emails/archives resolve too.

cynefin.title: Cynefin
cynefin.description: cynefin-beta — the five fixed sense-making domains (2x2 grid + central confusion ellipse with +N-more overflow), quoted items per domain, and labelled domain-to-domain transitions. Front-matter config + themeVariables domain colours applied.

swimlanes.title: Swimlanes
swimlanes.description: swimlane-beta — a flowchart whose top-level subgraphs render as lane bands (horizontal for TB/BT, columns for LR/RL); reuses the flowchart parser (drops accessibility lines). All flowchart node shapes + edge styles, including cross-lane edges.

graphviewer.title: Graph
graphviewer.description: Infinite zoom/pan canvas over the product-plus-code knowledge graph: communities, hyperedges, zoom LOD, a Segments rail and a property drawer. Opened as its own tab from the Product tab.

dotnet-verb-build.title: Build
dotnet-verb-build.description: dotnet build against the selected solution or project. Disabled without a target and while another verb runs; a successful build re-runs the outdated-package check.

dotnet-verb-run.title: Run
dotnet-verb-run.description: dotnet run against the selected target. A solution cannot be run, so a selected solution resolves to its startup project (see the Startup Project Picker); no runnable project leaves the button disabled and says why. Runs with no inactivity watchdog, since a launched GUI app is legitimately silent - Stop is how you end it.

dotnet-verb-restore.title: Restore
dotnet-verb-restore.description: dotnet restore against the selected target. A successful restore re-runs the outdated-package check, since restoring is what makes `dotnet list package --outdated` answerable.

dotnet-verb-test.title: Test
dotnet-verb-test.description: dotnet test against the selected target. Long-running by nature - Stop is how you end it.

dotnet-verb-clean.title: Clean
dotnet-verb-clean.description: dotnet clean against the selected target, removing its build outputs.

music-notation.title: Musical Notation
music-notation.description: #% … #% blocks (ABC + LilyPond) engraved to sheet music via a shared score IR and one native WPF renderer.

music-block.title: Block Extension
music-block.description: The #% custom Markdig block extension (MusicBlock + parser), dialect detection, and MusicRenderer dispatch into the pipeline.

score-model.title: Score Model (IR)
score-model.description: Shared WPF-free notation model (Score/Staff/Measure/Note/Rest/Chord/Pitch/Duration/Key/Time/Barline/Beam) both parsers target and the engraver consumes.

abc-notation.title: ABC Notation
abc-notation.description: ABC notation → Score IR parser: the practical language of abcnotation.com v2.1.

abc-core.title: ABC Core
abc-core.description: Header fields, pitches/octaves/accidentals, note lengths out to the breve, the unit note length, rests, whitespace beaming, every bar line form, repeat brackets, keys and modes, mid-tune key/meter/title changes.

abc-decorations.title: ABC Expression
abc-decorations.description: Broken rhythm, tuplets, ties, slurs, chords, grace notes, decorations (shorthand + !name!), chord symbols, placed annotations, lyrics (w:) and verses (W:).

abc-multivoice.title: ABC Multi-voice
abc-multivoice.description: V: voices → a bracketed system (one staff each, shared bar grid, clef inferred when unstated); inline fields [K:]/[M:]; %% directives skipped.

lilypond.title: LilyPond
lilypond.description: LilyPond → Score IR parser: the practical language of lilypond.org, at par with the ABC parser. Held to it by a cross-dialect parity test.

ly-core.title: LilyPond Core
ly-core.description: The language: \relative/\fixed/absolute pitch, Dutch note names, durations (breve→64th, dots, scaling), \clef/\key/\time, chords, ties/slurs, articulations, tuplets, grace notes, rests, repeats + \alternative. Three things ABC has no counterpart for: bars come from the meter (\partial, bar checks, \cadenzaOn), beams come from the meter, and a printed accidental is an engraving decision, not something the source asks for.

ly-scheme.title: Scheme/Comment Skip
ly-scheme.description: Tolerant skipping of #(…) Scheme, %{ %} + % comments, dynamics, and unknown \commands. A bare #-atom survives lexing as a token, because it is the value of an \override — blanking it would leave the assignment unterminated and swallow the next note.

ly-variables.title: Variables/Voices
ly-variables.description: Definitions (name = { … }) resolved inline at every \name reference, with a cycle guard — so \global flows into a voice. A file of definitions with no \score engraves the richest one.

ly-multistaff.title: Multi-staff / score
ly-multistaff.description: \score/\book, \new Staff/Voice with \with { instrumentName }, StaffGroup/ChoirStaff/PianoStaff/GrandStaff, simultaneous << >>. Voices that run in step are bracketed into one system by the engraver. Polyphony within a single staff engraves the first strand and reports the rest. Also \addlyrics / \lyricsto and \chordmode chord symbols, which are sibling contexts rather than staves.

ly-figuredbass.title: Figured Bass
ly-figuredbass.description: \figuremode / FiguredBass rendering. Currently parsed as a context, skipped, and reported in the score's warnings — the engraver has no figured-bass row.

ly-markup.title: Markup / Titles
ly-markup.description: \header mapped onto the front matter by where LilyPond prints each field (title centred, poet/meter top-left, composer + opus top-right, source under the score), a top-level \markup as the title, and note-attached ^"text" / _"text" annotations. Not yet: markup beyond a first string (font/layout commands).

score-renderer.title: Score Renderer
score-renderer.description: The single native-WPF sheet-music engraver (Bravura SMuFL font + WPF geometry).

sr-staff.title: Staff & Signatures
sr-staff.description: Staff lines, treble/bass clefs, key & time signatures, bar lines incl. repeats.

sr-notes.title: Notes & Rests
sr-notes.description: Note heads, stems, flags, augmentation dots, accidentals, rests, ledger lines.

sr-beaming.title: Beaming
sr-beaming.description: Primary + secondary beams (with the stub a broken pair's short note takes). The slope follows the group's contour but goes flat whenever that contour is not monotonic.

sr-layout.title: Layout & Systems
sr-layout.description: Systems, wrapping and justification: every system but a short tail shares one width, and the tail keeps its siblings' note spacing rather than its own natural one.

sr-theming.title: Theming
sr-theming.description: Ink/paper from the MarkdownPalette; graceful geometric fallback when the font is unavailable.

sr-grandstaff.title: Bracketed systems
sr-grandstaff.description: Several voices engraved as one system: a shared bar grid so the bar lines align, a bracket down the left, bar lines running through the staves, and voice names. Clef read off a voice's range when it names none.

sr-figuredbass.title: Figured Bass
sr-figuredbass.description: Figured-bass number rendering under a staff.

sr-slursties.title: Slurs/Ties/Tuplets
sr-slursties.description: Slur and tie curves (crossing bar lines and system breaks) and tuplet brackets/numbers.

sr-lyrics.title: Lyrics/Chords/Marks
sr-lyrics.description: Note-aligned lyric verses with hyphens and melisma extenders, chord symbols, placed annotations, articulations and ornaments. Dynamics/hairpins are not in ABC.

sr-midi.title: MIDI Playback
sr-midi.description: Play the score model as MIDI.

sr-selection.title: Selection
sr-selection.description: Click a measure to select it, drag to select a note group; themed highlight + SelectedRange/SelectionChanged.

diagram-text-selection.title: Diagram Text Selection
diagram-text-selection.description: Make text inside natively-drawn diagrams (mermaid/nomnoml labels) drag-selectable. Needs a selection layer over the Canvas renderers or FlowDocument-based labels - WPF text selection is FlowDocument-only today.

dotnet-startup-picker.title: Startup Project Picker
dotnet-startup-picker.description: Which project Run launches when a solution is selected: dotnet run cannot take a solution, so the solution is parsed for runnable projects (test projects and libraries excluded), the best guess is auto-picked, and a caret menu beside Run lets the user change it. The pick is remembered per solution.

dotnet-cancel.title: Cancel a Running Verb
dotnet-cancel.description: A Stop button, shown while a verb runs, that kills the dotnet process tree — the only way to end a Run (which has no inactivity watchdog, since a launched GUI app is legitimately silent) or a long dotnet test.

aichat-context-preview.title: Context Preview Panel
aichat-context-preview.description: Selecting a chip in the context strip opens a collapsible panel taking 35% of the width. A page that implements IContextPreview (Features.Common) renders its own read-only view there; a page that doesn't gets an identity placeholder showing the context text the AI actually sees. The panel's close button deselects the chip and collapses it.

aichat-rewind.title: Message Timestamps and Rewind
aichat-rewind.description: Each user bubble carries a relative timestamp (relative while it is still today, an absolute date once it is not). The newest user message also carries a Rewind button: it truncates the conversation back to that message - dropping it and everything after from the timeline, the token count and the saved record - and hands its text back to the AI input box.

aibar-slash-palette.title: Page Quick-Open
aibar-slash-palette.description: Type a slash then a page or ribbon name (or a bare exact name) in the AI input to jump to it. No popup: '/' is the handler's Symbol, so the status dot shows the slash and ghost-text completion suggests the match, like the other symbol handlers; Enter opens the resolved target. A slash-query that names nothing falls through to normal AI handling.

audio-background-play.title: Background play
audio-background-play.description: Toolbar toggle that keeps playback running when the tab is backgrounded, handing a pause/skip remote to the shell chrome (left of the activity ticker) and retaking over on reactivation.

text-viewer-ai.title: AI Integration
text-viewer-ai.description: How the assistant sees and acts on this page — get_context honesty, the client-tool surface, and the read-only context preview.

text-viewer-ai-context.title: Context — get_context
text-viewer-ai-context.note: Honest and visible-slice-aware: filename, path, dirty/editing state, encoding, total line count, and the actual on-screen numbered lines. Faithfully reflects the window the user sees.

text-viewer-ai-act.title: Act — client tools
text-viewer-ai-act.note: Full parity: read, search, line-edit, find/replace and save all funnel through the same TextViewModel/OverlayTextFile the user drives.

text-viewer-ai-act-copy-visible-text.title: copy_visible_text
text-viewer-ai-act-copy-visible-text.note: Not unit-tested: copies via System.Windows.Clipboard.SetText, which needs an STA thread and a live system clipboard — unavailable headless.

text-viewer-ai-act-read-lines.title: read_lines
text-viewer-ai-act-read-lines.note: Pages through the whole file beyond the resident window (up to 1000 lines per call), edit-aware — exceeds the slice the user sees.

text-viewer-ai-act-find-text.title: find_text
text-viewer-ai-act-find-text.note: Not unit-tested: primarily drives the on-screen search (highlights, minimap, SearchMatchCount set asynchronously by a fire-and-forget UI search); its AI summary is entangled with that live UI state.

text-viewer-ai-act-edit-lines.title: edit_lines
text-viewer-ai-act-edit-lines.note: Approval-gated line-range replace/insert/delete via the user overlay.

text-viewer-ai-act-replace-in-range.title: replace_in_range
text-viewer-ai-act-replace-in-range.note: Approval-gated find/replace within a line range.

text-viewer-ai-act-save-file.title: save_file
text-viewer-ai-act-save-file.note: Approval-gated streaming save of the merged edits.

text-viewer-ai-preview.title: Preview — IContextPreview
text-viewer-ai-preview.note: Implemented via IContextPreview: a compact, read-only ReadOnlyTextPreview (file name + meta + capped monospace snippet), built fresh so it never re-hosts the live editor. The control is shared (Visuals.Common) for reuse by other text-ish features.

log-viewer-ai.title: AI Integration
log-viewer-ai.description: How the assistant sees and acts on this page — get_context honesty, the client-tool surface, and the read-only context preview.

log-viewer-ai-context.title: Context — get_context
log-viewer-ai-context.note: Stub: reports only filename + loaded-line count; omits the visible tail content, the active regex/time/level filters, and the detected timestamp range. LineCount reflects only loaded (tail) lines until the head finishes streaming.

log-viewer-ai-act.title: Act — client tools
log-viewer-ai-act.note: read_tail / read_lines / search_log / read_selected_lines plus toolbar mirrors (regex + time filters, level highlights, tail pause) — all auto-run, view-only, no file mutation.

tabular-ai-context.title: Context — get_context
tabular-ai-context.note: Honest summary (columns with display types, row count or still-counting, a data sample of selected/visible rows) but omits active filters and sort, and is not IsContextReady-gated — can report still-counting or zero columns mid-load.

tabular-ai-act.title: Act — client tools
tabular-ai-act.note: read_rows reads cell content beyond the visible window; open_filter / scroll_to_top / scroll_to_end mirror the toolbar (view-only).

tabular-ai-act-open-filter.title: open_filter
tabular-ai-act-open-filter.description: Open the column filter side panel (does not set a filter).
tabular-ai-act-open-filter.note: Opens the filter panel (does not set a filter).

tabular-ai-act-scroll-to-top.title: scroll_to_top
tabular-ai-act-scroll-to-top.description: Move the view to the first row.
tabular-ai-act-scroll-to-top.note: Jumps the viewport to the first row.

tabular-ai-act-scroll-to-end.title: scroll_to_end
tabular-ai-act-scroll-to-end.description: Move the view to the last row.
tabular-ai-act-scroll-to-end.note: Jumps the viewport to the last row (loads the tail window).

tabular-ai-act-read-rows.title: read_rows
tabular-ai-act-read-rows.description: Read real cell content for a row range, beyond the window GetContext sampled.
tabular-ai-act-read-rows.note: Reads arbitrary rows/columns as data (start/count), so the AI can see cells past what GetContext sampled.

code-ai.title: AI Integration
code-ai.description: How the assistant sees and acts on this page: get_context honesty, the client-tool surface, and the read-only context preview.

code-ai-context.title: Context - get_context
code-ai-context.note: Honest and now readiness-gated: "Editing <file>" plus the first 4000 chars of the live document; the AI send waits for the load to finish (IsContextReady).

code-ai-act.title: Act - client tools
code-ai-act.note: Full parity via the shared editor base: read (get_editor_text), edit (set_editor_text / replace_all) and save (save_file). Reads auto-run; edits/save are approval-gated. Read-only for over-size files.

code-ai-act-get-editor-text.title: get_editor_text
code-ai-act-get-editor-text.note: Returns the full document buffer, beyond the viewport and the 4000-char context sample.

code-ai-act-get-syntax-tree.title: get_syntax_tree
code-ai-act-get-syntax-tree.note: Returns the tree-sitter AST s-expression; not something the user can see in the editor UI.

code-ai-preview.title: Preview - IContextPreview
code-ai-preview.note: Implemented via IContextPreview using the shared ReadOnlyTextPreview control (file name + meta + capped monospace snippet), inherited from the editor base so every editor gets it.

console-ai.title: AI Integration
console-ai.description: How the assistant sees and acts on this page: get_context honesty, the client-tool surface, and the read-only context preview.

console-ai-context.title: Context - get_context
console-ai-context.note: The terminal VM owns a live pseudo-console (cmd.exe/PTY); constructing it starts a real shell, so GetContext/GetSecurityContext are not unit-testable without an integration harness. The scope (GetSecurityContext => cwd) is guarded structurally by AiSurfaceRulesTests; reusable terminal input logic is covered by TerminalKeyHistoryTests/TerminalScreenTests.

console-ai-act.title: Act - client tools
console-ai-act.note: Real command-execution parity (run anything the user could), approval-gated, with automatic output capture and background completion watching. Guidance present.

console-ai-act-run-command.title: run_command
console-ai-act-run-command.note: run_command sends to a live cmd.exe/PTY and waits for the display to settle; not unit-testable without a live shell (integration/UI concern). The command classifier + key/history input logic is covered by TerminalKeyHistoryTests/TerminalScreenTests.

console-ai-preview.title: Preview - IContextPreview
console-ai-preview.note: IContextPreview not implemented (no feature is yet). A narrow read-only preview would let the conversation context panel show this page without re-hosting the live view.

json-ai-context.title: Context - get_context

json-ai-act.title: Act - client tools

hex-ai-context.title: Context - get_context

hex-ai-act.title: Act - client tools
hex-ai-act.note: read_bytes / find_bytes / get_selection to read beyond the visible window; goto/select/set_encoding view moves; overwrite_bytes + save (approval-gated) mirror the user edits.

markdown-ai-act.title: Act - client tools

markdown-ai-preview.title: Preview - IContextPreview

compressed-ai.title: AI Integration
compressed-ai.description: How the assistant sees and acts on this page: get_context honesty, the client-tool surface, and the read-only context preview.

compressed-ai-context.title: Context - get_context
compressed-ai-context.note: Accurate one-line summary (format, entry count, uncompressed size) but omits the visible entry tree, selection, and the encryption/signature status it computed.

compressed-ai-act.title: Act - client tools
compressed-ai-act.note: Read-only surface: list_entries / read_entry / test_archive. extract/add/sign/verify/recompress/convert stay user-only (dialogs, elevation, heavy backends).

compressed-ai-preview.title: Preview - IContextPreview
compressed-ai-preview.note: IContextPreview not implemented (no feature is yet). A narrow read-only preview would let the conversation context panel show this page without re-hosting the live view.

audio-ai-context.title: Context - get_context
audio-ai-context.note: Honest now-playing line: play state, resolved title/artist, and queue position.

audio-ai-act.title: Act - client tools
audio-ai-act.note: No client tools. The AI is a blind bystander - it cannot play/pause/seek/skip/reorder, edit tags, or read lyrics.

video-ai-act.title: Act - client tools
video-ai-act.note: video_capture_frame (see) + get_media_info (read) + seek (approval-gated, move the playhead).

video-ai-act-video-capture-frame.title: video_capture_frame

images-ai-context.title: Context - get_context

images-ai-act.title: Act - client tools

svg-ai-context.title: Context - get_context
svg-ai-context.note: Honest and readiness-gated: dimensions, viewBox, drawable-element count and file size, with distinct loading/failed states.

svg-ai-act.title: Act - client tools
svg-ai-act.note: Full for a static viewer: the AI sees the same art (render) and the same metadata (info).

svg-ai-act-render-svg-image.title: render_svg_image
svg-ai-act-render-svg-image.note: Rasterizes the frozen vector drawing to PNG - art the AI cannot get from metadata alone.

svg-ai-act-get-svg-info.title: get_svg_info
svg-ai-act-get-svg-info.note: Mirrors the footer (dimensions, viewBox, element count).

font-ai.title: AI Integration
font-ai.description: How the assistant sees and acts on this page: get_context honesty, the client-tool surface, and the read-only context preview.

font-ai-context.title: Context - get_context
font-ai-context.note: Honest and rich: each font by index + name + status + selection mark, plus preview text/size/style and the specimen line.

font-ai-act.title: Act - client tools
font-ai-act.note: Full parity plus more: mirrors the details panel and the rendered rows, with custom text/size overrides beyond the on-screen values.

font-ai-act-get-font-details.title: get_font_details
font-ai-act-get-font-details.note: Mirrors the details panel for any listed font.

font-ai-act-render-font-preview.title: render_font_preview
font-ai-act-render-font-preview.note: Rendering a font to an image uses WPF RenderTargetBitmap + PngBitmapEncoder, which needs an STA/interactive desktop and is not reliable headless (the existing FontClientToolsTests skips it for the same reason). Exercised via the UI journey.

font-ai-preview.title: Preview - IContextPreview
font-ai-preview.description: A scrollable, read-only list of the compared fonts for the conversation context panel: each font's Identity rows above an 'abcde' specimen set in that font at 14pt.
font-ai-preview.note: Built fresh on each chip selection and discarded on deselect, per the IContextPreview contract - a pinned page's live content cannot be re-hosted because a WPF element cannot have two parents. The control needs an STA thread to construct, so the unit test asserts the contract and the identity/specimen data it binds to; rendering is covered by the UI journey.

model3d-ai.title: AI Integration
model3d-ai.description: How the assistant sees and acts on this page: get_context honesty, the client-tool surface, and the read-only context preview.

model3d-ai-context.title: Context - get_context
model3d-ai-context.description: get_context: readiness-gated; once the mesh loads, the model's format and triangle/vertex/mesh/material counts and render mode.
model3d-ai-context.note: Honest and readiness-gated: format, triangle/vertex/mesh/material counts, render mode, and any unsupported elements.

model3d-ai-act.title: Act - client tools
model3d-ai-act.note: Gold standard: every toolbar camera/inspect action plus wireframe toggle, and the AI can orbit to inspect unseen sides then re-capture.

model3d-ai-act-capture-viewport-image.title: capture_viewport_image
model3d-ai-act-capture-viewport-image.description: Render the current 3D viewport and return it as an image.
model3d-ai-act-capture-viewport-image.note: Producing the image renders the live HelixViewport3D (STA/GPU) - not unit-testable headless, like the other capture/render tools. The no-viewport graceful-error path is covered by Model3DViewModelTests.CameraTools_FailGracefully_WithoutViewport.

model3d-ai-act-get-model-info.title: get_model_info
model3d-ai-act-get-model-info.description: Get exact triangle/vertex/mesh counts, the material list, and non-rendered file contents.

model3d-ai-act-orbit-model.title: orbit_model
model3d-ai-act-orbit-model.description: Rotate the camera around the model (yaw left/right, pitch up/down, in degrees).
model3d-ai-act-orbit-model.note: Rotates to inspect sides not currently visible.

model3d-ai-act-roll-model.title: roll_model
model3d-ai-act-roll-model.description: Roll the camera about the line of sight, in degrees.
model3d-ai-act-roll-model.note: Rolls the camera beyond the initial pose.

model3d-ai-act-zoom-model.title: zoom_model
model3d-ai-act-zoom-model.description: Zoom the camera (factor above 1 zooms in, between 0 and 1 zooms out).
model3d-ai-act-zoom-model.note: Zooms to detail the user has not framed.

model3d-ai-act-pan-model.title: pan_model
model3d-ai-act-pan-model.description: Pan the camera (dx right/left, dy up/down, as a fraction of the viewport).
model3d-ai-act-pan-model.note: Pans to off-screen parts of the model.

model3d-ai-act-reset-view.title: reset_view
model3d-ai-act-reset-view.description: Re-frame the model so the whole thing fits in the viewport.
model3d-ai-act-reset-view.note: Returns the camera to the default pose.

model3d-ai-act-set-render-mode.title: set_render_mode
model3d-ai-act-set-render-mode.description: Switch between solid and wireframe rendering.
model3d-ai-act-set-render-mode.note: Toggles solid/wireframe to reveal internal structure.

web-viewer-ai-context.title: Context - get_context
web-viewer-ai-context.note: Thin: URL + loading flag. The page title and content are not included (the tools compensate). Not readiness-gated.

web-viewer-ai-act.title: Act - client tools
web-viewer-ai-act.note: See + scroll only - the AI cannot click links, navigate, or interact as the user can. No guidance.

web-viewer-ai-act-capture-web-page.title: capture_web_page
web-viewer-ai-act-capture-web-page.note: Capturing the page renders a live WebView2; the not-wired error path is covered by WebAiTests, the actual screenshot needs a live browser control and is not unit-testable headless.

web-viewer-ai-act-scroll-web-page.title: scroll_web_page

virtual-disk-viewer-ai-act-read-file.title: read_file
virtual-disk-viewer-ai-act-read-file.description: Text of one in-disk file by path via the VFS; guards missing/dir/oversize/binary.

images-ai-act-capture-image.title: capture_image
images-ai-act-capture-image.description: PNG-encode the current image and return it as a ContextImage vision attachment.
images-ai-act-capture-image.note: Not unit-tested: PNG-encodes a WPF BitmapSource (PngBitmapEncoder), not reliable off an interactive/STA desktop; the UI journey covers the real pixel path.

images-ai-act-get-image-info.title: get_image_info
images-ai-act-get-image-info.description: Filename / format / pixel dimensions / file size / position as text.

images-ai-act-next-image.title: next_image
images-ai-act-next-image.description: Step to the next image (clamps at last, no wrap).

images-ai-act-previous-image.title: previous_image
images-ai-act-previous-image.description: Step to the previous image (clamps at first, no wrap).

video-ai-act-get-media-info.title: get_media_info
video-ai-act-get-media-info.description: Container/duration/position/state/speed/volume and, once parsed, codec/resolution/audio/subtitle rows as text.

video-ai-act-seek.title: seek
video-ai-act-seek.description: Move the playhead to a timestamp (seconds), clamped to duration. Approval-gated.

audio-ai-act-control-playback.title: control_playback
audio-ai-act-control-playback.note: Success path drives the live AudioPlaybackEngine + an output device (none headless); argument validation and the no-track guard are covered by AudioAiTests, the actual play/pause/stop effect is not unit-testable.

audio-ai-act-seek.title: seek
audio-ai-act-seek.note: Seeking needs a loaded engine + output device (none headless); the no-track and bad-position guards are covered by AudioAiTests, the actual seek is not unit-testable.

audio-ai-act-next-track.title: next_track
audio-ai-act-next-track.note: Mid-queue advance loads the next track through the engine; the no-op-at-last-track guard is covered by AudioAiTests.Navigation_NoOpsAtQueueBoundaries, the advance itself is not unit-testable.

audio-ai-act-previous-track.title: previous_track
audio-ai-act-previous-track.note: Mid-queue rewind loads the previous track through the engine; the no-op-at-first-track guard is covered by AudioAiTests.Navigation_NoOpsAtQueueBoundaries, the rewind itself is not unit-testable.

text-viewer-save.title: Save
text-viewer-save.description: Toolbar Save button, visible while editing (also Ctrl+S), that persists the edited file.

text-viewer-cut.title: Cut
text-viewer-cut.description: Toolbar Cut button - edit-only (hidden in read-only); bound to the editor Cut command, disabled without a selection.
text-viewer-cut.note: Delegates to a WPF ApplicationCommands verb against a focused editor - no VM state to unit-test; presence / edit-only visibility is covered by the UI journey (TextJourneyTests).

text-viewer-copy.title: Copy
text-viewer-copy.description: Toolbar Copy button - always visible; bound to the editor Copy command, disabled without a selection.
text-viewer-copy.note: Delegates to a WPF ApplicationCommands verb against a focused editor - no VM state to unit-test; presence / edit-only visibility is covered by the UI journey (TextJourneyTests).

text-viewer-paste.title: Paste
text-viewer-paste.description: Toolbar Paste button - edit-only (hidden in read-only); bound to the editor Paste command.
text-viewer-paste.note: Delegates to a WPF ApplicationCommands verb against a focused editor - no VM state to unit-test; presence / edit-only visibility is covered by the UI journey (TextJourneyTests).

text-viewer-searchbar.title: Search Bar
text-viewer-searchbar.description: State-governed overlay shown while a search is active: the search term + match count and its navigation.

text-viewer-search-indicator.title: Search Indicator
text-viewer-search-indicator.description: Displays the active search term and its match count.

text-viewer-clear-search.title: Clear Search
text-viewer-clear-search.description: Button that clears the active search and hides the search bar.

text-viewer-split-panel.title: Split Panel
text-viewer-split-panel.description: State-governed overlay (opened by the toolbar Split toggle) to break a too-large file into smaller files.

text-viewer-split-mode.title: Split Mode
text-viewer-split-mode.description: Combo selecting how to split the file (by size, by lines, etc.).

text-viewer-split-value.title: Split Value
text-viewer-split-value.description: Input for the split parameter, with a contextual hint.

text-viewer-split-run.title: Split Now
text-viewer-split-run.description: Button that performs the split into files.

text-viewer-split-close.title: Close
text-viewer-split-close.description: Button that closes the split panel.

text-viewer-statusbar.title: Status Bar
text-viewer-statusbar.description: Footer showing file size, line count, match count (while searching) and the streaming indicator.

text-viewer-status-filesize.title: File Size
text-viewer-status-filesize.description: Footer display of the file's size.

text-viewer-status-linecount.title: Line Count
text-viewer-status-linecount.description: Footer display of the file's line count.

text-viewer-status-matchcount.title: Match Count
text-viewer-status-matchcount.description: Footer display of the search match count (shown while a search is active).

text-viewer-context-menu.title: Context Menu
text-viewer-context-menu.description: Editor right-click menu: Cut / Copy / Paste (the same ApplicationCommands the toolbar buttons invoke).
text-viewer-context-menu.note: Pure XAML right-click menu invoking the same WPF ApplicationCommands (cut/copy/paste) against a focused editor - nothing VM-testable; covered by the UI journey.

text-viewer-file-banner.title: File-Changed Banner
text-viewer-file-banner.description: Banner overlaid at the top of the editor when the underlying file changes on disk.

text-viewer-highlights.title: Search Highlights
text-viewer-highlights.description: Highlights every search match in the visible text (a background renderer layer).

text-viewer-func-encoding-detect.title: Encoding Detection
text-viewer-func-encoding-detect.description: Auto-detects the file's encoding (BOM / UTF-8 sniff) on load; the Encoding selector shows and overrides it.

text-viewer-func-monitoring.title: File Monitoring
text-viewer-func-monitoring.description: Watches the file on disk (debounced) and raises the file-changed banner; the Monitor toggle enables it.

text-viewer-func-editing.title: Confined-Window Editing
text-viewer-func-editing.description: Editing confined to the resident window (read-only-section provider) with an overlay engine mapping edits back to the file.

text-viewer-func-splitting.title: File Splitting
text-viewer-func-splitting.description: Splits a too-large file into smaller editable files by the chosen mode/value.

edit-mode.title: Edit_mode
edit-mode.description: State node controls which are active when editing is active

selection.title: Selection
selection.note: 'Selection' is an AvalonEdit TextArea (view) concept; the VM exposes only CurrentCaretOffset, no selection-range / copy-enablement state to unit-test. Covered by the UI journey.

ui-2.title: UI
ui-2.description: Everything the user sees or touches in the Web tab: the nav toolbar (back / forward / read-only address / reload / open-externally), the browser surface itself, and the panel that replaces it when the embedded browser cannot start.

product-sunburst.title: Sunburst
product-sunburst.description: The main Product tab (sunburst arc): browse/edit the node tree, concerns and snaplinks.

product-integrity.title: Integrity
product-integrity.description: The Integrity page: snaplink-validation issues + test-coverage advisories, with in-place re-point/remove.

product-func.title: Functionality
product-func.description: Feature-level behaviours shared across the Product pages.

graph-canvas.title: Canvas - pan / zoom / render
graph-canvas.note: STA render/interaction surface: the code-behind drives the Scale/Translate transform, wheel-zoom-to-cursor, armed pan and the CompositionTarget.Rendering tween. The interactive behaviours (realise / zoom LOD / node cap) are the Graph Functionality leaves.

graph-communities.title: Community colouring
graph-communities.note: Deterministic value converter mapping a community index to a themed Swatch brush (with a last-resort fallback); visually verified. The community list + visibility toggle is the Segments rail (graph-segments).

graph-drawer.title: Property drawer
graph-drawer.note: Passive display bound to the selected node; exercised via the selection tests + the Graph UI journey.

graph-load.title: Graph load
graph-load.description: Read graph.json into bound VM collections (GraphLoader).

graph-layout.title: Layout (force / focus / hybrid)
graph-layout.description: Deterministic force/focus/hybrid layout with a quadtree; pins the focus node.

graph-build.title: Graph build
graph-build.description: Build the product-plus-code knowledge graph: containment, snaplinks, calls, hyperedges, communities.

graph-cache.title: Graph cache
graph-cache.description: Incremental, byte-deterministic graph cache keyed by per-file content hashes.

integrity-advisories.title: Coverage advisories
integrity-advisories.description: Non-gating declared-but-unlinked [CoversNode] advisories with one-click Add link.

integrity-relink.title: Re-point / remove link
integrity-relink.description: Fix an issue in place: pick a real target, or remove the link; rows re-bind after edits.

integrity-validate.title: Snaplink validation
integrity-validate.description: SnaplinkValidator: file/heading/class/method/url + node-link checks; unverifiable vs broken.

integrity-scan.title: Test-coverage reconcile
integrity-scan.description: Reconcile the [CoversNode] manifest against the tree: advisories, unknown-node, gating missing-snaplink.

graph-realise.title: Neighbourhood realisation
graph-realise.description: Realise the hop-radius neighbourhood (BFS) into the bound node/edge collections.

graph-lod.title: Zoom LOD
graph-lod.description: Level-of-detail: hide finer node/edge kinds as the canvas zooms out.

graph-cap.title: Node cap
graph-cap.description: Cap the realised node count, always keeping the focus, and report the remainder.

git-pull-result.title: Action Result Line
git-pull-result.description: Transient italic line under the bar reporting the outcome of a pull or a failed load; fades out after a few seconds.

git-worktree-mode.title: Worktree_mode
git-worktree-mode.description: State node - the controls that appear only when the open folder is a linked git worktree.

git-worktree-badge.title: Worktree Badge
git-worktree-badge.description: 'worktree' pill shown for a linked worktree, with a tooltip spelling out its merge and push state; its merged/unmerged and pushed/unpushed state is also appended to the status line. A broken remnant (dangling .git link) reads as an error.

git-worktree-remove.title: Remove Worktree
git-worktree-remove.description: Danger-styled 'Remove' button that deletes the worktree folder, prunes it and deletes its branch. A merged, clean worktree goes without a prompt; anything unmerged, dirty or broken confirms first, spelling out exactly what is lost.

git-read-service.title: Repository Reads
git-read-service.description: LibGit2Sharp-backed reads behind every display and every AI tool: working-tree status with ahead/behind, log, diff (working tree or staged), branches, a commit's message+diff, and remotes.

git-worktree-service.title: Worktree Detection & Removal
git-worktree-service.description: Detects a linked worktree (its .git is a file, not a directory), reports merge/push state against the mainline, and removes one - deleting the folder, pruning git's worktree record and deleting the branch. A dangling .git link yields a 'broken remnant' record rather than throwing, so it can still be cleaned up.

git-credentials.title: Credential Handling
git-credentials.description: Resolves push/fetch credentials by shelling out to the system credential manager (git credential fill), and stores a user-supplied access token (git credential approve) after the pull fallback captures one.

git-viewlet-match.title: Folder Match
git-viewlet-match.description: Which folders get a Git bar: GitViewlet matches a .git *directory* (a main checkout), GitWorktreeViewlet matches a .git *file* (a linked worktree's gitdir pointer). Mutually exclusive, and neither applies to a drive root.

dotnet-open-target.title: Open Target
dotnet-open-target.description: The ↗ button beside the target, always present so the affordance never moves, that opens the selected solution/project with its default OS handler (e.g. Visual Studio for a .sln/.slnx).

dotnet-target-scan.title: Target Discovery
dotnet-target-scan.description: Scans the open folder for .slnx / .sln / .csproj / .fsproj / .vbproj and orders them solution-first, so a folder holding both offers the solution as the default target.

dotnet-solution-reader.title: Solution Reading
dotnet-solution-reader.description: Parses a .slnx / .sln for its projects (skipping solution folders, resolving paths relative to the solution) and decides which are runnable - an exe/WinExe/Web SDK project, never a library or a test project.

dotnet-cli.title: Command Execution
dotnet-cli.description: Runs a dotnet verb as a child process, streaming its output back for the inline progress line and killing the whole process tree on cancel. `run` deliberately has no inactivity watchdog - a launched GUI app is legitimately silent.
dotnet-cli.note: Launches a real `dotnet` child process and manages its Win32 process tree - no seam to fake without reimplementing it. The guard paths (no target, cancel-while-idle) are unit-tested on the view-model; real execution is exercised by the app itself.

dotnet-startup-cache.title: Startup Project Memory
dotnet-startup-cache.description: Remembers which project the user chose to Run for a given solution, so the pick survives a folder revisit; a remembered project that is no longer runnable is discarded rather than honoured.

dotnet-nuget-check.title: Outdated Package Check
dotnet-nuget-check.description: Background `dotnet list package --outdated` for the selected target, cached for a day and re-run on target switch and after a restore/build. Runs from a neutral working directory so it never locks the folder, and a debounce means folders merely passed through are never checked.
dotnet-nuget-check.note: Shells out to a real `dotnet list package --outdated` against a restored target - too slow and network-dependent for a unit test. Its result handling (the caution badge, the tooltip, clearing when nothing is outstanding) is unit-tested via dotnet-nuget-caution.

dotnet-viewlet-match.title: Folder Match & Quiesce
dotnet-viewlet-match.description: Which folders get a .NET bar (one holding a .slnx/.sln or a project file), and releasing the folder on demand: the NuGet check is cancelled and any running verb's process tree is killed, so the folder can be renamed or deleted (e.g. by a git worktree removal).
dotnet-viewlet-match.note: The glob match is declarative registration data and the quiesce path kills a live child process tree; neither has VM state to assert. Presence of the bar for a solution folder is covered by the UI journey.

ui-3.title: UI
ui-3.description: Everything the user sees or touches in the Font tab: the preview top bar, the compare list, the details panel for the selected font, and the add-a-font picker overlay.

copy-name.title: Copy Name
copy-name.description: Copies the selected font's display name to the clipboard.
copy-name.note: The unit test covers the guard (nothing selected copies nothing). The clipboard write itself is a single WPF call wrapped in try/catch - the clipboard can be locked by another process - and needs an interactive desktop, so it is exercised by the UI journey.

select-font-style.title: Face Variant Chips
select-font-style.description: Chip strip of the family's faces (Regular / Bold / Italic / ...); picking one re-renders that font's preview row in that face and repoints the metadata rows and glyph map at it.

view-glyph.title: Glyph Grid
view-glyph.description: The paged grid of the face's mapped characters, rendered in that face. Capped per page so a large CJK font never realises tens of thousands of cells, with Prev / Next and a page label.

copy-glyph.title: Copy Glyph
copy-glyph.description: Clicking a glyph cell copies that character to the clipboard, like Character Map.
copy-glyph.note: The unit test covers the guard (an empty cell copies nothing). The clipboard write itself needs an interactive desktop and is exercised by the UI journey.

functionality-3.title: Functionality
functionality-3.description: Behaviours behind the viewer that are not a UI control or an AI tool: how a font file is turned into something WPF can render, and the entry points that open the tab.

list-panel.title: List Panel
list-panel.description: The left-hand surface: one preview row per chosen font, with the add-a-font button beneath.

add-font.title: Add Font
add-font.description: Button under the compare list that opens the font picker overlay to add another font to compare.

font-details-2.title: Metadata Rows
font-details-2.description: The grouped detail rows read from the selected face's GlyphTypeface: identity, style and metrics, legal / licensing and technical fields. A font that failed to load shows its error here instead.

font-selected.title: Font Selected
font-selected.description: State node - the panels that only have anything to show once a font in the compare list is selected.

topbar.title: Topbar
topbar.description: The top bar spanning the tab: the editable preview string and the size slider that restyle every compare row at once.

size-slider.title: Size Slider
size-slider.description: 8-120pt slider setting the preview size for every row at once, snapped to whole points and shown beside the slider. WPF renders in DIPs, so the value is converted (pt x 4/3) for the previews.

font-text-display.title: Preview Text
font-text-display.description: The editable sample string, applied live to every row in the compare list as it is typed.

remove-font.title: Remove Font
remove-font.description: Per-row close button that drops that font from the compare list, reselecting a neighbour so the details panel is never left showing a font that is gone.

copy-path.title: Copy Path
copy-path.description: Copies the selected font's file path to the clipboard. Does nothing for an installed system font, which has no source path of its own.
copy-path.note: The unit test covers the guard (an installed family has no source path, so nothing is copied). The clipboard write itself needs an interactive desktop and is exercised by the UI journey.

font-decode-pipeline.title: Decoder registry
font-decode-pipeline.description: The generic half: FontSourceResolver asks each registered IFontFormatDecoder whether it handles the extension, writes the decoded bytes to a temp file and hands back a Uri, cleaning the temp files up on dispose. A file needing no decoding is passed through as-is. Adding WOFF2 is one more decoder plus a filemap line - no change here.

font-decode-woff.title: WOFF decoder
font-decode-woff.description: The one format implemented today: parses the WOFF header and table directory and zlib-inflates each compressed table back into an sfnt WPF can load. WOFF2 is a future sibling (Brotli plus table-transform reversal).

winfs-keyboard-open.title: Open Selected (Shift+Enter)
winfs-keyboard-open.description: Shift+Enter opens the selected entry via the same OpenEntryCommand the row's double-click binding uses: folders navigate, files go through the default-open resolver. Shift-modified because the AI input holds focus and owns plain Enter. Single selection only.

git-ai-act-git-log-ranges.title: Revision ranges & filters
git-ai-act-git-log-ranges.description: git_log gains a revision range (A..B) plus --since/--until/--author/--grep/--no-merges. Without a range the tool can only walk back from a tip, so 'what changed between two releases' cannot be expressed at all; the 200-commit cap makes tip-walking unusable at release scale.

git-ai-act-git-diff-refs.title: Two-ref diff & output format
git-ai-act-git-diff-refs.description: git_diff gains from/to revisions (tags, branches, hashes) and a format switch: stat | name-only | patch. Today it only diffs uncommitted work, and always returns full patch text capped at 600 lines - useless at release scale, where a --stat summary is the only readable first answer.

git-ai-act-git-tags.title: git_tags
git-ai-act-git-tags.description: List tags (optionally matching a pattern) with their target commit and date, plus describe for the nearest tag to a ref. Nothing in the surface exposes tags today, so the assistant cannot even discover that a release boundary such as v1.3.0 exists.

git-ai-act-git-file-at.title: git_file_at
git-ai-act-git-file-at.description: Read a file's contents as of any revision (git show <rev>:<path>). The only way to answer 'what did this config/default look like before' - currently impossible, since every read is against the working tree.

git-ai-act-git-merge-base.title: git_merge_base
git-ai-act-git-merge-base.description: Merge base and ahead/behind counts between two ARBITRARY refs. git_status only reports ahead/behind against the current branch's upstream, so 'how far is this branch from main' is unanswerable.

git-ai-act-git-contains.title: git_contains
git-ai-act-git-contains.description: Which branches and tags contain a given commit, and whether ref X is fully merged into ref Y. This is the 'is it safe to delete this branch' question, and the honest answer to 'did we lose that work'.

git-ai-act-git-blame.title: git_blame
git-ai-act-git-blame.description: Line-by-line authorship and last-touching commit for a file or line range, so the assistant can answer 'who changed this and why' and follow the trail into the commit message.

git-ai-act-git-search-history.title: git_search_history
git-ai-act-git-search-history.description: Search history rather than the working tree: pickaxe -S/-G for when a string appeared or vanished, and --grep over commit messages. Answers 'when did we stop doing X' - today only the current checkout is searchable.

git-ai-act-git-recovery.title: git_recovery
git-ai-act-git-recovery.description: List stashes, and read the reflog. The recovery surface: reflog is what proves nothing was lost after a branch delete, reset or bad merge, and it is the only place work that is not on any branch still shows up.

git-ai-act-git-worktrees.title: git_worktrees
git-ai-act-git-worktrees.description: Enumerate every linked worktree of the repo with its branch, dirty/unpushed/merged state and whether it is a broken remnant. GitWorktreeService already computes all of this, but only for the folder currently open - the assistant cannot see the others.

git-ai-act-forge.title: Forge integration (PRs & issues)
git-ai-act-forge.description: Read pull requests and issues from the repository's hosting forge, behind a provider abstraction: GitForgeClient carries no forge-specific knowledge, and each backend (host match, URL shapes, auth, JSON mapping) is one IGitForgeProvider in GitForgeRegistry. Supporting another forge is a new provider plus a registry line - nothing in the client or the tools changes.

git-ai-act-git-compare.title: git_compare
git-ai-act-git-compare.description: One call for 'what is the difference between A and B': ahead/behind counts, the changed-file stat, and the commit list. Directly answers the release-comparison question the current surface fails.

git-ai-act-git-changelog.title: git_changelog
git-ai-act-git-changelog.description: Release notes for a range: non-merge commit subjects PLUS merged pull-request titles, grouped, with a file-stat summary and contributors. The tool that writes WhatsNew.md - assembled by hand from six commands on 2026-07-22.

git-ai-act-git-branch-audit.title: git_branch_audit
git-ai-act-git-branch-audit.description: Every branch with upstream, whether the upstream is gone, commits not on the mainline, whether a worktree holds it, and any backing PR. The whole 'is this safe to prune' review in one call, instead of a nervous five-command dance.

git-ai-act-git-find-work.title: git_find_work
git-ai-act-git-find-work.description: Find work by topic across branches, tags, stashes, reflog and remote PRs - the 'where did that change go' question. High user value: work removed with its worktree looks deleted while being perfectly safe, and this is what proves it.

git-ai-act-git-file-history.title: git_file_history
git-ai-act-git-file-history.description: Commits touching a path, following renames, with the option to fetch the file's content at any of them. Combines git_log --follow with git_file_at so a file's evolution is one call rather than N.

git-ai-act-forge-prs.title: git_pull_requests
git-ai-act-forge-prs.description: List pull requests from GitHub or Bitbucket - state filter, title search, source/target branches and author. PR titles are the best release-note material there is, and a PR is often the only surviving record of why a branch exists.

git-ai-act-forge-issues.title: git_issues
git-ai-act-forge-issues.description: List issues from GitHub or Bitbucket. GitHub's issues endpoint also returns pull requests; those are dropped so the two tools do not double-report.

git-ai-act-forge-providers.title: Providers
git-ai-act-forge-providers.description: The forge backends registered in GitForgeRegistry. Each is one IGitForgeProvider - host match, repo-path parsing, endpoint URLs, auth scheme and JSON mapping. Add a node here when adding a provider so the supported set stays visible in the tree.

git-ai-act-forge-github.title: GitHub
git-ai-act-forge-github.description: GitHub (and Enterprise hosts named *github*): owner/repo paths, bearer-token auth, bare-array listings with head.ref / base.ref branch fields; drops PRs from the issues endpoint.

git-ai-act-forge-bitbucket.title: Bitbucket
git-ai-act-forge-bitbucket.description: Bitbucket Cloud: workspace/repo paths, basic auth (x-token-auth access tokens), values-wrapped pages with source.branch.name / destination.branch.name; caps-and-repeated state vocabulary.

git-ai-act-forge-azure.title: Azure DevOps
git-ai-act-forge-azure.description: NOT YET BUILT. Azure DevOps: org/project/_git/repo paths (three levels - GitForgeRepo.Project already models this), basic auth with a PAT, and its own PR/issue (work-item) JSON. Add a GitForgeProvider + a GitForgeRegistry line; the extension point is proven by the FakeAzureProvider test.

git-ai-act-forge-abstraction.title: Provider abstraction
git-ai-act-forge-abstraction.description: IGitForgeProvider + GitForgeRegistry: the seam that keeps GitForgeClient forge-agnostic. A provider passed to the client is used with no other change - proven by ANewProvider_PluggedIn_IsUsedWithoutTouchingTheClient.
